title: Spatial Audio Generation and Editing with Executable Plans and Self-Distilling Transfusion
abstract: arXiv:2610.34415v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial audio authoring coordinates source decisions with soundfield synthesis. For editing, plans specify what to change and retain, while reference audio supplies further acoustic detail. We present AMBIT, a unified framework for native First-Order Ambisonics (FOA) generation and editing with three connected contributions. First, a shared Transfusion backbone couples autoregressive planning with rectified-flow rendering through executable ScenePlans that specify source content, activity, and 3D trajectories. For editing, the plan describes the full target scene, including retained sources; contrastive features ground the requested change, while full reference latents supply residual acoustic detail for preservation. Second, an FOA-aware continuous VAE combines shared-decoder omnidirectional recovery, asymmetric grouped KL, and spatial covariance matching to preserve content and inter-channel structure. translated_title: 基于可执行计划与自蒸馏Transfusion的空间音频生成与编辑
translated_abstract: 空间音频创作需要将声源决策与声场合成相协调。在编辑任务中，计划指定需要修改与保留的内容，而参考音频则提供进一步的声学细节。我们提出AMBIT，一个用于原生一阶Ambisonics（FOA）生成与编辑的统一框架，包含三项相互关联的贡献。第一，共享的Transfusion主干网络通过可执行的ScenePlans将自回归规划与整流流渲染相耦合，ScenePlans指定声源内容、活动状态与三维轨迹；在编辑时，该计划描述完整的目标场景（包括需保留的声源），对比特征锚定所请求的修改，而完整的参考潜变量提供用于保留的残余声学细节。第二，FOA感知的连续VAE结合共享解码器的全向恢复、非对称分组KL散度与空间协方差匹配，以保留内容与通道间结构。第三，联合Transfusion训练……（原文此处截断）
tldr: AMBIT提出了一个统一的一阶Ambisonics（FOA）空间音频生成与编辑框架，通过可执行场景计划将自回归规划与整流流渲染相耦合，并结合FOA感知的VAE与自蒸馏训练，实现高保真声场合成与精准的场景编辑。
en_tdlr: AMBIT is a unified framework for native First-Order Ambisonics (FOA) spatial audio generation and editing that couples autoregressive planning with rectified-flow rendering via executable ScenePlans, supported by an FOA-aware VAE and self-distilling Transfusion training.
